name: api-monitor
description: Intelligent API Monitoring & Alert System (backend + dashboard)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
